scope: Independent survival world; normal production mayfly grant, logical double-space entry and W motion. F5 uses vanilla KeyMapping.click/consumeClick. No forced camera position, remote avatar, forced shader route or pre-enabled ordinary flight. Pixel candidate is a diagnostic proxy backed by saved actual screenshots, not a draw-count success claim. No native GLFW physical-key certification.
glStageScope: AFTER_PARTICLES before/after priority brackets the production geometry callback and compares BlendMode.lastApplied identity plus actual framebuffer, blend factors/equations, texture, depth/cull/scissor/color-mask state. GL_PROGRAM is recorded without a strict equality claim. AFTER_LEVEL and final RenderTick END cover deferred composites plus intervening vanilla rendering; differences there are observations, not automatically a leak. GUI-pre observation runs after higher-priority listeners. Each stage retains its own sample tick; no-GUI captures may carry a previous GUI-pre sample. GL errors are recorded at every stage.
